fact: The GAINAfrica project (Horizon Europe, La Sapienza) is testing a multilingual mobile app for crop-disease identification and precision agriculture in Uganda, per AIM.
The Uganda Catholic Medical Bureau authors state that Uganda uses AI-assisted chest X-ray screening (CAD4TB) in TB screening, applying a national threshold of 50 to identify presumptive TB cases.

A retrospective review of 6,000 West Nile X-ray records (2021-2024) reports CAD4TB v7 at the national 50 threshold had 96.3% sensitivity and 98.0% specificity, identifying 181 of 188 GeneXpert-confirmed cases with 274 referrals.

Makerere University says the VectorCam AI mosquito-identification app was piloted with the National Malaria Control Programme from November 2022 to April 2024 and is to be scaled to 22 districts, 12 with embedded research.
Uganda Revenue Authority Commissioner General John Rujoki Musinguzi said URA used AI to identify tax evasion such as undeclared imports and false VAT claims.
Musinguzi said URA recovered 200 billion shillings in revenue leakages uncovered through the use of AI in the previous year.
